how.title: How it works
how.lead: From your printed menu to ordering and paying from the table, in four steps.

steps.title: Import your menu
steps.body: Upload the PDF or a photo. Mezza reads dishes, prices and options, and learns your style. You confirm anything unclear before publishing.

steps.title: Print your QR codes
steps.body: Design the codes in your colors and download sheets to cut, folded table tents, or stickers.

steps.title: Guests order and pay
steps.body: They scan, see your menu in their language, order to the kitchen, call the server, and pay with ATH Móvil, card or cash.

steps.title: Close on your terminal
steps.body: Mezza shows each table's total to enter on your fiscal terminal, as you do today, and keeps your reports and IVU.

terms.title: Terms of use
body: Mezza is a service of Stratum PR LLC, based in Trujillo Alto, Puerto Rico, that lets restaurants show their menu, take orders and get paid from the table.
The restaurant is responsible for its menu, its prices, the IVU it charges, and closing each sale on its fiscal terminal. Mezza does not issue fiscal receipts.
You can cancel your account anytime. We'll give you access to download your reports for a reasonable period.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
body: We collect the data needed to run the service: the restaurant and team accounts, orders and payments.
Guests who order from the table don't need an account. If they leave a phone number for a receipt, we only use it with their consent.
We don't sell personal data. Card and ATH Móvil payments are handled by certified processors.

data.title: Data processing agreement
body: The restaurant controls its guests' data; Stratum PR LLC processes it only to provide the service.
Data is stored encrypted, separated by restaurant, and only authorized staff can see it.
Stratum support access requires the owner's approval, expires, and is logged.
